links.outcome: Real-world accuracy of deployed AI versus adjudicated ophthalmologist grades on sampled images
links.effect: Sensitivity 97.0% and specificity 96.4% for severe NPDR/PDR; STDR sensitivity 95.9%, specificity 94.9%; clinically important miss rate 0%.
links.quote: ARDA's sensitivity and specificity for severe NPDR or PDR were 97.0% (95% CI, 92.6%-99.2%) and 96.4% (95% CI, 95.7%-97.0%), respectively.

screen.reason: This study evaluates the post-deployment clinical performance and accuracy of a deep learning diabetic retinopathy screening algorithm (ARDA) across 45 clinical sites in India, but does not compare or test specific deployment practices or safeguards.
